title: Recoil and Energy Loss of a Squid
body: A $$5.00-kg$$ squid initially at rest ejects $$0.250\, \text{kg}$$ of fluid with a velocity of $$10.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$. $$The$$ $$ejection$$ $$is$$ $$done$$ $$in$$ $$0.100\, \text{s}$$ and there is a $$5.00-N$$ frictional force opposing the squid's movement.
